skills.name: Context Compass: Repo Prep & Proof-Driven Changes
skills.takeaway: Trace each requested behavior to proof before you edit.

steps.d: Label each claim Verified, Inferred or Unknown.
Local scan as an index, then read the real source.
Criterion to contract, code, callers and test proof.

below.t: Unknown that matters? Stop and ask.

steps.d: Failing test first, then the smallest edit. Only if asked.
Run allowed checks. Record run and not run apart.
A six-part text brief.

below.t: Never "done" while a criterion lacks proof.

result: Files changed and why, or proposed files
Exact commands and what really ran
Remaining unknowns and the smallest next step
limits: Returns text, not a PDF or file
No correctness guarantee
No whole-repo "ready" verdict
Read-only unless you ask for the change

run.title: a scanner change in this repository

lines: Request: show API and schema contract files in the repo map
Scanner lists contracts/openapi.yaml as a lead, not proof

npm run check passes: typecheck, lint, build, tests
Brief returned. One unknown kept: which contract governs a code path

skills.name: Evidence QA v1: Conversation Reviews with Checked Quotes
skills.takeaway: Score conversations on your rubric, with every quote checked.

steps.d: Offline demo and checks. Node.js 22 or newer.
Your criteria and an explicit speaker label.
Your credentials and destinations, kept out of output.

below.t: Access or consent missing? Stop and name the gap.

steps.d: Assess each criterion. Check quotes against the transcript.
Report and sheet rows. Resume without model replay.
Compare flagged criteria with the transcript.

below.t: A person decides. Drafts are not verdicts.

result: What a person still has to check
limits: Drafts, not final decisions
A found quote does not prove the label
No employment decisions
An offline pass does not prove live provider access

No provider credentials needed offline

skills.name: Quality Department — Idea to Production QA
skills.takeaway: A go or no-go you can defend, criterion by criterion.
outputs: Ready / Not ready / Cannot say yet
Next action per gap, with owner

steps.d: Read the requirements. Number the criteria.

below.t: No stated criteria? Cannot say yet. Ask.

steps.d: The test or check behind each criterion.
Would it fail if the criterion broke?

below.t: Green but proves nothing? Report a test gap.

steps.d: The suite, plus the spec example by hand.
Decision first, then gaps and owners.

below.t: Ready is a recommendation. Deploying is your call.

result: Ready, Not ready, or Cannot say yet
Criterion, evidence, what it proves, status
Passing tests that prove nothing, apart from bugs
Who does what for each open item
limits: Does not deploy
Does not invent requirements
Not for fixing one test or reviewing code style
Nothing is production-verified unless observed there

run.title: the refund casebook
lines: Ticket criteria AC1 to AC3 read and numbered
Existing smoke test found: green
Its check would stay green for a wrong amount
Charged 1,000, refunded 700, request 500: expected 300, observed 500
Not ready: AC1 fails. Owner: payments engineer
After the fix: 300, 300 and 0. Recommend for this ticket
run.verdict: Not ready, then Ready after the rerun

skills.name: Skill Release Handoff — Check the ZIP You Send
skills.takeaway: Check the exact ZIP the recipient gets, not the folder.

steps.d: Folder, ZIP, contract, prerequisites, evidence directory.
Source and archive, each read as data.
Folder against ZIP, file by file.

below.t: Differs or missing? REVISE. Name the owner.

steps.d: Only declared, fixed version probes.
Four separate verdicts, never merged.

below.t: PASS: hand over the exact ZIP SHA-256.

steps.d: First task result tied to that ZIP.

result: Differing or missing files, if any
Owner and what to do next
limits: PASS does not prove task behavior
Not a security, install or deployment check
No marketplace acceptance
Changed inputs need a new run and evidence directory

run.title: a repaired folder shipped in an old ZIP
run.source: an illustrative case, not a recorded run
lines: Inputs fixed. Evidence directory sits outside the folder
Source audit and archive audit each report
Parity: one file differs between folder and ZIP
REVISE: owner rebuilds the ZIP
New ZIP, new evidence directory. Prerequisites met
PASS: ZIP SHA-256 handed to the recipient
run.verdict: REVISE, then PASS on the rebuilt ZIP

skills.name: UI Recheck — Before & After
skills.takeaway: Same states, same widths, before and after, measured.

steps.d: States, widths and assertions from the real API.
Snapshots and adapters that mount the real component.

below.t: No component seam? Stop. No mock stands in.

steps.d: A local Node.js server and a session receipt.
Same scenario and width on each side.
Failed, unsupported and unfinished stay visible.
JSON and HTML results.

result: Scenario and width, before and after
Text and state, overflow, click callback, focus target
Exact restart command for an interrupted run
limits: No screenshots or pixel comparison
Not an accessibility or release sign-off
Does not edit or deploy product code
Not a full browser regression suite

skills.name: Campaign Export Handoff
skills.takeaway: Which placement ships, who fixes what, what needs re-measuring.

steps.d: Placements against guide rules. An owner for each.
To the file SHA-256, guide revision and observer.
Every placement row is read.
READY, FIX or HOLD.
Schedule list and a fix queue per designer.
Replacements measured again.

below.t: READY cites digest and revision. Producer decides.

result: Cleared placements, with digest and revision
File, failed rule, observed, target, next action
Omitted or extra placements, for the producer
limits: The producer owns the publish decision
Old measurements never clear a new file
An unavailable proof stays open
Sample files and approval are fictional

lines: Feed and story placements reconciled with the guide

HOLD: story file changed, old measurements belong to another digest
